figures.name: methodology_four_stages
figures.caption: Four stages of the completed methodology. Moment linkage is proved per request with the exact assigned change; all candidate decisions require full authenticated coverage.

figures.name: methodology_interval_refinement
figures.caption: Illustration of interval refinement after dividing integer endpoints by T⁶. A base interval spanning zero is inconclusive; authenticated exact-row corrections can establish a negative upper endpoint. The drawn endpoints are illustrative.

figures.name: 06_measured_warm_pilots
figures.caption: Previously measured laptop timings, not new server results. Fashion8 is a paired warm comparison; the final text16 all-Full run is separate from the earlier pair. Setup reuse and measured timing boundaries are explicit. No error bars or broad performance claims are inferred from single executions.

figures.name: 07_rank_coverage_native_only
figures.caption: Existing native integer-bound ablation with fixed prediction rank63 and correction cap16. The plot measures conclusive bound coverage for one exploratory fit, not ZK runtime, formal soundness probability or classification accuracy.

figures.name: 05_cost_aware_variant
figures.caption: The tested cost-aware engineering variant. Native exact computations only select witness work. A batch activates compact proofs only when predicted savings cover loading/setup and a margin. Every request is retained and publicly verified. This variant is not silently inserted into the existing methodology text.
